blocks.text: The programme includes private transfers and excursions with an English-speaking guide-interpreter or guide-driver. All 4 nights are at **Mercure 4*** in Quito, with breakfast. In just a few days, you will see colonial architecture, the Andes, tropical vegetation and a crater lake. The drives between excursions reveal how quickly Ecuador's altitude and natural zones change.
